title: Organon : From Evolutionary Search to Recursive Self-Improving Agents for Scientific Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.33046v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scientific discovery does not follow a single fixed methodology: research methods vary across domains and evolve through experimentation as investigations unfold. Although LLM-guided evolutionary search has advanced automated discovery, existing frameworks typically rely on fixed search procedures or restrict adaptation to predefined components, limiting their ability to address diverse research problems and adapt to challenges that emerge at runtime. We introduce Organon, a recursively self-improving agent for scientific discovery. During execution, a single persistent agent analyzes its accumulated experience and autonomously revises its own search strategies, population management, diagnostic tools, memory, and worker coordination. These revisions take effect at runtime, allowing the agent to continuously adapt its approach as research progresses. translated_title: Organon：从演化搜索到面向科学发现的递归自我改进智能体
translated_abstract: 科学发现并不遵循单一固定的方法论：研究方法因领域而异，并随着研究的展开通过实验不断演进。尽管由大语言模型（LLM）引导的演化搜索推动了自动化发现的进展，但现有框架通常依赖于固定的搜索程序，或将适应性局限于预定义的组件，这限制了它们应对多样化研究问题以及适应运行时涌现挑战的能力。我们提出了 Organon，一个面向科学发现的递归自我改进智能体。在执行过程中，单一持久化的智能体会分析其积累的经验，并自主修订自身的搜索策略、种群管理、诊断工具、记忆以及工人协调机制。这些修订在运行时即刻生效，使智能体能够随着研究进展持续调整其方法。重要的是，该智能体还能够诊断并纠正其自身适应过程中的缺陷。
tldr: 该论文提出 Organon，一个能在运行时自主分析经验并修订自身搜索策略、工具与协调机制的递归自我改进智能体，突破了固定演化搜索框架的局限，实现了面向科学发现的持续自适应。
en_tdlr: Organon is a recursively self-improving agent that autonomously analyzes its accumulated experience and revises its own search strategies, tools, and coordination at runtime, enabling continuous adaptation for scientific discovery beyond fixed evolutionary search frameworks.
